title: The Whole Truth
description: A Hollywood producer's (Stewart Granger) wife (Donna Reed) does not believe he has stabbed his actress lover, another man's (George Sanders) wife.

title: Scandal Sheet
description: When a New York tabloid editor (Broderick Crawford) accidentally kills his wife, his best reporters (Donna Reed, John Derek) figure it out.

title: The Running Man
description: An insurance man (Alan Bates) gets chummy in Spain with a couple (Laurence Harvey, Lee Remick) who have collected on a fake death.

title: Eight Iron Men
description: GIs sit in a bombed-out house with a comrade trapped outside; then one (Bonar Colleano) does something.

title: The Wrecking Crew
description: Secret agent Matt Helm (Dean Martin) and a blonde (Sharon Tate) track $1 billion in gold in the last of four Matt Helm movies.

title: Tell It to the Judge
description: A lawyer (Robert Cummings) chases his lawyer ex-wife (Rosalind Russell) from Florida to the Adirondacks, where she poses as a playboy's (Gig Young) wife.

title: Operation Mad Ball
description: An Army private (Jack Lemmon) and his buddies try to fraternize with nurses who are off-limits as officers.

title: Hook, Line and Sinker
description: A man (Jerry Lewis) runs up a fortune in bills after his doctor (Peter Lawford) tells him he has only months to live.

title: A Raisin in the Sun
description: Proud members (Sidney Poitier, Claudia McNeil, Ruby Dee) of a Chicago family argue over a $10,000 insurance windfall.

title: Dr. Strangelove Or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb
description: President Muffley and his advisers man the Pentagon war room, as planes with bombs head toward Moscow.

title: Easy Rider
description: Two free spirits (Peter Fonda, Dennis Hopper) on chopped motorcycles clash with the Establishment and meet a boozy lawyer (Jack Nicholson) as they cross America.

title: The Game That Kills
description: A man infiltrates a hockey team to investigate the death of his brother, the team's star left wing.

title: Queen Bee
description: A boozing Atlanta millionaire's (Barry Sullivan) wicked wife (Joan Crawford) acts charming to people at their mansion.

title: The Guilt of Janet Ames
description: A World War II widow (Rosalind Russell) overcomes a mental block thanks to one (Melvyn Douglas) of the five soldiers her husband died for.

title: What a Woman!
description: An author (Willard Parker) and a literary agent (Rosalind Russell) become involved after selling film rights to his racy book.

title: The Trouble With Angels
description: A headstrong girl (Hayley Mills) and her best friend (June Harding) bedevil the mother superior (Rosalind Russell) of a convent school.

title: Middle of the Night
description: A widowed manufacturer (Fredric March) falls in love with a divorced employee (Kim Novak) 30 years his junior.

title: The Jolson Story
description: At the turn of the 20th century, young Asa Yoelson decides to go against the wishes of his cantor father and pursue a career in show business.

title: Twentieth Century
description: An actress (Carole Lombard) deserts the Broadway director (John Barrymore) who bolstered her career, then meets him on the Chicago-New York express.

title: Easy Rider
description: Two free spirits (Peter Fonda, Dennis Hopper) on chopped motorcycles clash with the Establishment and meet a boozy lawyer (Jack Nicholson) as they cross America.

title: A Man for All Seasons
description: Sir Thomas More (Paul Scofield) opposes Henry VIII's (Robert Shaw) appointing himself head of the Church of England.

title: Anatomy of a Murder
description: A Michigan lawyer (James Stewart) and his colleague defend an Army lieutenant (Ben Gazzara) who killed the man who raped the officer's wife (Lee Remick).

title: Shockproof
description: An ex-convict (Patricia Knight) flees with her Los Angeles parole officer (Cornel Wilde) after shooting her former lover (John Baragrey).

title: We Were Strangers
description: A Cuban (Jennifer Jones) lets a rebel (John Garfield) use her home as a base for digging a tunnel to blow up a dictatorship.

title: Love Has Many Faces
description: A woman (Lana Turner) lives in Acapulco with moochers and a husband (Cliff Robertson) who married her for her money.

title: Paula
description: A boy left mute by a hit-and-run accident discovers his speech teacher (Loretta Young) was the driver.

title: A Woman of Distinction
description: Scandalous rumors link the dean (Rosalind Russell) of a women's college with a professor of astronomy (Ray Milland) from England.

title: Miss Sadie Thompson
description: A shady woman (Rita Hayworth) from San Francisco joins Marines and a moral reformer (Jose Ferrer) in the postwar Pacific.

title: The Happy Time
description: A violinist (Charles Boyer) and his brother (Louis Jourdan) guide one's son through his crush on the family maid in the 1920s Ottawa.

title: Walk, Don't Run
description: A British businessman (Cary Grant) shares an apartment with a U.S. athlete (Jim Hutton) and a diplomat's fiancée (Samantha Eggar) during the Tokyo Olympics.

title: Cat Ballou
description: When an outlaw (Lee Marvin) with a fake nose kills her father, a schoolmarm (Jane Fonda) hires his drunken twin to get revenge.

title: Dr. Strangelove Or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb
description: President Muffley and his advisers man the Pentagon war room, as planes with bombs head toward Moscow.

title: From Here to Eternity
description: While a Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor looms, an Army sergeant (Burt Lancaster), a former boxer (Montgomery Clift) and an officer's wife (Deborah Kerr) become entangled with others at an Army base on Oahu.

title: The Long Gray Line
description: On the eve of his retirement, an Irish immigrant looks back upon his lifetime of service to West Point military academy.

title: Bell, Book and Candle
description: A witch's (Kim Novak) warlock brother (Jack Lemmon) helps a San Francisco publisher (James Stewart) break a love spell.

title: The Key
description: A tugboat captain (William Holden) inherits an apartment and a woman (Sophia Loren) from another tugboat captain (Trevor Howard) in World War II England.

title: The Magic Carpet
description: An ousted prince harnesses the power of a mystical floor covering to drive a villainous caliph from the throne.

title: Only Angels Have Wings
description: A sassy chorus girl (Jean Arthur) falls in love with a seat-of-the-pants pilot (Cary Grant) in South America.

title: The Heroes of Telemark
description: A freedom fighter (Richard Harris) and a scientist (Kirk Douglas) sink a shipment of heavy water en route to Berlin from a Nazi factory in Norway.

title: Fail-Safe
description: The president (Henry Fonda) cannot stop a Strategic Air Command plane accidentally cued to bomb Moscow.

title: The Wackiest Ship in the Army
description: A captain (Jack Lemmon) and his ensign (Ricky Nelson) take a sorry ship and crew on a World War II spy mission.
